data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 20
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on. ✨= today's motto,⏰ = work, ₿ = money, ❤️ = taken, ⚤ = single

data.title: 12 Thais back, 27 sent home
data.description: SA KAEO: Authorities have received 12 Thais repatriated from Cambodia and sent home 27 Cambodians who had completed legal proceedings in Thailand.

data.title: Accountant held over thefts
data.description: Police have arrested a 27-year-old accountant accused of embezzling nearly 23 million baht from a Bangkok entertainment company to buy virtual gifts for TikTok streamers.

data.title: Border home pilot to launch
data.description: A "Secure Border Housing" pilot project for injured soldiers and vulnerable communities is set to launch in five border provinces, the government says.

data.title: Chile's Bachelet quits race to be next UN chief
data.description: SANTIAGO (CHILE) - Michelle Bachelet, the former president of Chile, withdrew her candidacy for the position of United Nations secretary-general on Saturday, weeks after a straw poll showed her in second to last place among eight candidates.

data.title: Triple gold shots for Thai teqball doubles stars
data.description: Teqball stars will be bidding to win the gold medals for the Thai contingent after they reached the finals of the women's doubles, mixed doubles and men's doubles events on Saturday.

data.title: Davis strikes in injury time as Uthai Thani stun Ayutthaya
data.description: Benjamin Davis struck in injury time as Uthai Thani came from behind to win 2-1 at Ayutthaya United in the Thai League 1 on Friday night.

data.title: War Elephants eyeing last-8 spot with a victory over Hong Kong
data.description: Thailand target another three points as they take on Hong Kong in their second Group A match in the 20th Asian Games men's football tournament at Toyota Stadium in Japan on Sunday.

data.title: Five cheers for Kingdom's heroes as they celebrate golden wins
data.description: Thailand's national golf team brought home five titles at the Southeast Asian Amateur Golf Team Championships 2026 in Hong Kong on Friday.

data.title: The biggest sporting show begins
data.description: Nagoya: The 20th Asian Games were declared open by Japan's emperor on Saturday following a troubled build-up to the multi-sport spectacular that has more athletes than the Olympics.

data.title: Akanat unveils solar scheme
data.description: Energy Minister Akanat Promphan has unveiled plans to reform Thailand's power structure by expanding household solar rooftop capacity to 10,000MW, allowing households to generate electricity for their own use and sell surplus power back to the grid.

data.title: DRT tightens watch on longest rail tunnel
data.description: The Department of Rail Transport (DRT) has stepped up inspections of the Den Chai–Chiang Rai–Chiang Khong line, now 70.6% complete, as work continues on Thailand's longest rail tunnel.

data.title: Five officers face probe after Chiang Mai gambling raids
data.description: Police are preparing to investigate five Chiang Mai officers for negligence after administrative officials raided two long-running gambling dens in the city centre and detained more than 100 people.

data.title: PP head calls for new charter
data.description: People's Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has marked the 20th anniversary of the Sept 19, 2006 coup by calling for a new constitution, citing more than 21 million votes earlier this year in favour of beginning the process.

data.title: Hundreds of households hit by severe weather
data.description: Flash floods hit communities in several provinces from North to South after heavy and prolonged rain caused rivers to overflow, with hundreds of households affected and authorities stepping up evacuation and disaster-response measures.

data.title: PM to show 'Thai potential' while overseas
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will embark on a three-nation tour to Japan, the United States, and the United Kingdom this week. The trip aims to showcase Thailand's economic potential, boost market confidence and attract foreign investment.

data.title: Mexico eyes areas of cooperation
data.description: Mexico is working with Thailand on marine conservation, sustainable fishing and LGBTQ+ services as the North American country seeks new areas of cooperation, its ambassador says.

data.title: EC's shockwave upsets 'blue camp'
data.description: The Election Commission (EC)'s decision to refer the Senate vote-rigging case, which involves 77 suspects, to the Supreme Court has put 26 serving senators from the so-called "blue camp" -- politicians linked to the ruling Bhumjaithai (BJT) Party -- at the centre of a legal process that could shift the balance of power in the upper house.

data.title: Dems demand review of frigate plan
data.description: The Democrat Party on Saturday demanded the Defence Ministry revise its 17‑billion‑baht frigate procurement plan, citing potential corruption in the bidding process.

data.title: 'It has to stop': runners protest women's murders in S.Africa district
data.description: KEMPTON PARK (SOUTH AFRICA) - Hundreds of runners gathered Saturday in South Africa's Kempton Park, near Johannesburg, where the body of a 38-year-old mother was discovered earlier this month -- one of nine woman to be murdered in the district in two months.

data.title: Cuba works to restore power after another blackout
data.description: HAVANA - Cuba worked Saturday to restore power after its seventh major blackout of the year, as the communist-run island grappled with woes triggered by a US fuel blockade.

data.title: France's debt climbs to highest since 1978: ministry
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - France's debt mountain is growing and will this year be at its highest level since 1978 because of a soaring deficit, the country's finance ministry said Saturday.

data.title: Arsenal thrashed by Brighton, sorry Spurs lose again
data.description: LONDON - Arsenal's perfect start to their Premier League title defence came off the rails in a 3-0 trouncing by Brighton, while Tottenham remain winless after a 3-2 defeat to Aston Villa.

data.title: CNN, MS NOW denied access to White House grounds
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US media outlets CNN and MS NOW said they were denied access to the White House grounds on Saturday, a day after President Donald Trump announced a ban against them for reporting what he calls "fake news."

data.title: 'Fragile' Tottenham beaten by Aston Villa despite late rally
data.description: LONDON - The end to Tottenham's Premier League goal drought came too late as Aston Villa won 3-2 in north London on Saturday to compound a miserable start for Roberto De Zerbi's men.

data.title: Martin wins Austrian MotoGP sprint after Acosta crash
data.description: SPIELBERG (AUSTRIA) - Jorge Martin won Saturday's Austrian MotoGP sprint race to retake the championship lead from Marc Marquez, after Pedro Acosta crashed out with victory in sight.

data.title: Saudi capital issues air raid alert
data.description: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia - Saudi authorities issued their first air raid alert in the capital since fighting returned to neighbouring Yemen, leaving residents of Riyadh rattled after they heard explosions ringing out in the early hours of Saturday.

data.title: Malaysian minister resigns to protest Najib pardon
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - The ​leader ‌of Malaysia’s Democratic Action Party (DAP) said ​on Saturday that he would resign as ⁠transport minister over a Pardons Board decision ​to allow house arrest for former ​prime minister ‌Najib Razak.
